title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15-Inch Solid Brass | Retro Wave Collection Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your kitchen organization with a wall mount paper towel holder crafted from solid brass to help keep countertops clean and clutter-free.

  • Retro Wave collection: traditional, refined styling designed to coordinate with matching retro wave pieces
  • Wall-mounted: saves counter space and keeps paper towels within easy reach
  • Solid brass construction: crafted from the finest solid brass materials
  • Clean install: concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Finish options: available in multiple designer finishes

Specifications

  • Dimensions: 15 in H x 4 in L x 2.25 in W
  • Projection: 5 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
